{{Short description|Swiss chemist}}
'''René P. Schwarzenbach''' (born 18 December 1945) in [[Erlenbach, Switzerland|Erlenbach]]<ref name="Diss" /> is a Swiss chemist. He is professor emeritus of environmental chemistry and a former head of the department of environmental sciences at the [[ETH Zurich|ETH Zürich]].

Schwarzenbach received his Ph.D. 1973 at the department of chemistry at the ETH Zürich.<ref name="Diss">René P. Schwarzenbach: ''Beitrag zur Automatisation im organisch-analytischen Laboratorium; Echtzeitdatenerfassungssystem für die niederauflösende Massenspektrometrie''. Diss. Techn.Wiss. ETH Zürich, Nr. 5204, 1973, {{doi|10.3929/ethz-a-000105253}}.</ref> In 1977 he has accepted a position at the [[Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology]] (Eawag), where he worked until 2006. Since 2000 he has been listed in the database of [[ISI Highly Cited|Highly Cited Researchers]] published by the [[Institute for Scientific Information]] (ISI). In 2001 he received the SETAC Environmental Education Award. In 2006 he received the Award for Creative Advances in Environmental Science & Technology from the [[American Chemical Society]].<ref>Eawag: [http://www.novaquatis.eawag.ch/media/20060328 Hohe Ehre für René Schwarzenbach] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160108121405/http://www.novaquatis.eawag.ch/media/20060328 |date=2016-01-08 }}.</ref> A special issue of the ACS journal ''[[Environmental Science & Technology]]'' was devoted to Schwarzenbach in July 2013.<ref>[http://pubs.acs.org/toc/esthag/47/13 Environmental Science & Technology, Vol. 47, Iss. 13].</ref>
